mentions.name: Vestiges
mentions.description: A 2D narrative strategy rogue-like built in Godot. The demo is nearly complete: most tutorial features and content are finished, ready modes support full keyboard-only play, and an MCP server lets Claude playtest the game as a player would. A Steam release is in progress (identity verification underway), with the demo technically shippable but held back pending stronger writing.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've continued working on my game project, Vestiges, which is a 2D narrative strategy rogue-like in Godot.
mentions.author: ksaun
